title: CALM: A Calibrated LLM Choice Network Framework for Activity-Based Traveler Simulation
abstract: arXiv:2609.22252v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present CALM, a reproducible hybrid framework that integrates an optional large language model (LLM) activity planner with calibrated stochastic choice, shared network feedback, memory and habit, typed feasibility checks, and deterministic offline replay. Unlike trip-mode classifiers or diary-only generators, CALM executes a closed traveler-day loop and evaluates each generative module against an empirical, reproducible baseline. On the 2024 New York City Citywide Mobility Survey (CMS), 110,691 seven-mode trips are split by respondent into 78,487 training and 32,204 holdout trips. Training-only alternative-specific constant calibration reduces mean holdout mode Jensen-Shannon divergence from 0.15599 to 0.00394 across ten seeds. translated_title: CALM：一种用于基于活动的出行者模拟的校准大语言模型选择网络框架
translated_abstract: 我们提出了CALM，这是一个可复现的混合框架，它将可选的大语言模型（LLM）活动规划器与校准的随机选择、共享网络反馈、记忆与习惯机制、类型化可行性检查以及确定性离线回放相结合。与出行方式分类器或仅基于出行日记的生成器不同，CALM执行一个封闭的出行者一天循环，并针对经验性、可复现的基线评估每个生成模块。在2024年纽约市全市出行调查（CMS）数据上，110,691次七种出行方式的行程按受访者划分为78,487次训练行程和32,204次保留测试行程。仅使用训练数据的备选方案特定常数校准，在十次随机种子下将保留集出行方式的平均Jensen-Shannon散度从0.15599降低到0.00394。随后的匹配实时LLM消融实验量化了总体拟合、时间拟合、行为持久性和可行性之间的权衡，同时冻结的提示-响应对支持下游模拟的确定性回放。
tldr: CALM是一个可复现的混合框架，将可选的LLM活动规划器与校准随机选择模型相结合，在纽约市出行调查数据上将出行方式预测的Jensen-Shannon散度从0.15599大幅降至0.00394，并通过消融实验量化了LLM在总体拟合、时间拟合、行为持久性和可行性之间的权衡。
en_tdlr: CALM is a reproducible hybrid framework that integrates an optional LLM activity planner with calibrated stochastic choice, reducing holdout mode Jensen-Shannon divergence from 0.15599 to 0.00394 on NYC mobility survey data while quantifying LLM trade-offs among aggregate fit, temporal fit, behavioral persistence, and feasibility.
